about_the_game:
Overview:

Project 2025 Text Based Story Board is an AI-powered interactive story creation platform that enables users to craft unique narratives using their own AI service APIs. This tool does not include any built-in API keys - users must provide their own valid AI service credentials.

【Core Features】

- Trilingual Support: Full compatibility with Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, and English

- Dynamic Story Engine: Generates organic narrative branching

【System Requirements】

• Valid AI service API key (e.g., DeepSeek/Local LLM)

• Stable internet connection

• Basic text processing capability

Project 2025 Text Based Story Board is a narrative tool that transforms your AI service API into a powerful storytelling engine.

[Important Notice]

This tool does not include any built-in API services. Users must provide their own valid AI service credentials to access all features.
